items.title: Shifts in forest management intensity mediate biodiversity outcomes under contrasting socio-economic and climate scenarios
items.title_en: Shifts in forest management intensity mediate biodiversity outcomes under contrasting socio-economic and climate scenarios
items.title_zh: 在不同的社会经济和气候情景下，森林管理强度的变化对生物多样性结果产生介导作用
items.summary_en: Forest extent and forest management are both important in shaping biodiversity responses to climate and land use changes. Yet biodiversity impact models typically represent managed forests as an aggregated category despite advances in land use models that differentiate between forest management practices. This limits the ability to assess how shifts between management practices impact biodiversity under future scenarios. We addressed this gap by coupling the biodiversity model GLOBIO with the agent-based land use model CRAFTY-EU. GLOBIO simulates changes in mean species abundance (MSA) in response to drivers of biodiversity loss. CRAFTY-EU allocates land uses including six forest management practices with different timber harvesting intensities based on societal demands and socioeconomic and biophysical suitability. We integrated GLOBIO’s climate change, land use, and updated forest management MSA estimates to evaluate biodiversity outcomes under three socioeconomic and climate scenarios (SSP1-RCP2.6, SSP3-RCP7.0, and SSP5-RCP8.5). Forest expansion partially buffered biodiversity loss only where agricultural abandonment was substantial and climate impacts were moderate. This effect was strongest under SSP1-RCP2.6, weaker under SSP5-RCP8.5 because climate losses dominated, and largely absent under SSP3-RCP7.0 due to limited abandonment and forest decline. Across all scenarios, shifts towards intensive forest management reduced MSA, showing that forest expansion alone does not guarantee biodiversity benefits, especially under management intensification and strong climate change. Land use and forestry policies that promote forest recovery while avoiding management intensification can moderate biodiversity losses, but are unlikely to compensate for strong climate-driven declines. Such policies align with the EU’s Nature Restoration Regulation, which proposes planting 3 billion trees and restoring 20% of land by 2030. Successful implementation requires consideration of prior land use to avoid converting biodiversity-rich areas and planting and management strategies that ensure positive biodiversity outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 森林覆盖范围和森林管理在塑造生物多样性对气候和土地利用变化的响应方面都至关重要。然而，尽管土地利用模型在区分不同森林管理措施方面已取得进展，但生物多样性影响模型通常仍将受管理的森林视为一个汇总类别。这限制了我们评估未来情景下不同管理措施之间的转变如何影响生物多样性的能力。 我们通过将生物多样性模型GLOBIO与基于代理的土地利用模型CRAFTY-EU耦合，解决了这一问题。GLOBIO模拟了物种平均丰度（MSA）对生物多样性丧失驱动因素的响应变化。 CRAFTY-EU 根据社会需求以及社会经济和生物物理适宜性，分配土地利用类型，其中包括六种具有不同木材采伐强度的森林管理实践。 我们整合了GLOBIO模型中的气候变化、土地利用以及更新的森林管理MSA估算结果，以评估三种社会经济与气候情景（SSP1-RCP2.6、SSP3-RCP7.0和SSP5-RCP8.5）下的生物多样性结果。 只有在农业弃耕面积较大且气候影响适中的情况下，森林扩张才能部分缓解生物多样性丧失。这种效应在SSP1-RCP2.6情景下最为显著，在SSP5-RCP8.5情景下较弱（因气候损失占主导），而在SSP3-RCP7.0情景下则基本不存在（因弃耕面积有限且森林退化程度较轻）。 在所有情景中，向集约化森林管理转型均导致MSA下降，这表明仅靠森林扩张并不能保证带来生物多样性效益，特别是在管理集约化程度加深和气候变化加剧的情况下。 那些在促进森林恢复的同时避免管理强度的土地利用和林业政策，可以缓解生物多样性损失，但不太可能弥补由气候变化导致的严重衰退。此类政策与欧盟的《自然恢复条例》相一致，该条例提议到2030年种植30亿棵树并恢复20%的土地。要成功实施该条例，需要考虑……

items.title: Quantifying temporal changes in the monetary value of forest cultural ecosystem services globally: a meta-analysis
items.title_en: Quantifying temporal changes in the monetary value of forest cultural ecosystem services globally: a meta-analysis
items.title_zh: 量化全球森林文化生态系统服务货币价值的时变趋势：一项荟萃分析
items.summary_en: The world’s forests, and the biodiversity they contain, provide multiple cultural ecosystem services that are essential to people’s well-being. However, interactions between people and forests evolve alongside broader societal and environmental change, raising questions about whether the values associated with forest cultural ecosystem services have shifted over time. To examine this, we conducted a global meta-analysis of 137 economic valuation studies comprising 705 observations gathered over the four decades between 1980 and 2019. Our results did not provide evidence of statistically significant temporal trends for travel cost, contingent valuation, choice experiment, or hedonic pricing estimates. Likewise, a recreation-only subsample did not provide evidence of a statistically significant temporal trend in monetary values over time. Although a diversity of cultural ecosystem service classes and forest types were examined, the existing evidence base is biased towards high-income countries, and valuation studies remain heavily concentrated on recreational interactions with forests, while spiritual and symbolic interactions are rarely quantified. Such gaps in our knowledge limit our ability to quantify the monetary value of forest cultural ecosystem services globally. Although we did not find evidence of temporal trends in the value people place on forest cultural ecosystem services, the substantial heterogeneity and method-specific patterns observed in our models suggest that temporal stability should not be assumed when undertaking benefit transfers. Given these findings, methodological heterogeneity and contextual differences should be considered when applying benefit transfer methods in environmental decision-making. The scarcity of studies in low- and middle-income countries, combined with a strong focus on recreation, underscores the need for broader and geographically diverse valuation research. Addressing these gaps may support more context-sensitive approaches to forest management and conservation.
items.summary_zh: 全球森林及其所蕴含的生物多样性，为人类福祉提供了多种文化生态系统服务。然而，人类与森林之间的互动随着更广泛的社会和环境变化而演变，这引发了一个问题：与森林文化生态系统服务相关的价值是否随时间推移而发生了变化。 为探讨这一问题，我们对1980年至2019年这四十年間收集的137项经济估值研究（共705个观测值）进行了全球性荟萃分析。研究结果未发现旅行成本、条件估值、选择实验或享乐定价估算存在具有统计学意义的时序趋势。 同样，仅针对休闲活动的子样本也未显示货币价值随时间存在统计学上显著的趋势。尽管研究涵盖了多种文化生态系统服务类别和森林类型，但现有证据基础存在向高收入国家倾斜的偏倚，且估值研究仍高度集中于与森林的休闲互动，而精神与象征性互动则极少被量化。 这些知识缺口限制了我们量化全球森林文化生态系统服务货币价值的能力。尽管我们未发现人们对森林文化生态系统服务所赋予的价值存在时间趋势的证据，但模型中观察到的显著异质性及特定方法模式表明，在进行效益转移时不应假设其具有时间稳定性。 鉴于这些发现，在环境决策中应用效益转移方法时，应考虑方法论异质性和情境差异。中低收入国家相关研究匮乏，加之研究重点过度集中于休闲活动，凸显了开展更广泛且地域多元化的估值研究的必要性。弥补这些空白有助于支持采取更具情境敏感性的方法

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01931-7The petrochemical sector is a major source of greenhouse gas emissions, yet a consistent facility-level emissions inventory is missing, hindering effective sectoral decarbonization. This study fills the gap through a bottom-up and detailed assessment of 37,379 facilities globally.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》，在线发表于：2026年9月9日； doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01931-7 石化行业是温室气体排放的主要来源，但目前缺乏一致的设施级排放清单，这阻碍了该行业的有效脱碳。 本研究通过对全球37,379家设施进行自下而上且详细的评估，填补了这一空白。

The agency verified the presence of a wolf in the far north end of the county, county supervisor Brad Rasmussen said in a statement on social media. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 官员表示，一种标志性物种——该物种曾在该州灭绝，后于2011年重新引入——已被发现，且其分布范围正在扩大。加州野生动物官员证实，自该物种15年前重返该州以来，最近在加利福尼亚州门多西诺国家森林中首次发现了一只灰狼。位于旧金山以北约两小时车程的莱克县官员上周表示，加利福尼亚州鱼类和野生动物局（CDFW）已收到关于8月下旬在该森林内目击狼的报告。该县监督委员布拉德·拉斯穆森在社交媒体上发表的声明中称，该机构已证实该县最北端确实有一只狼。 继续阅读...

items.summary_en: From rare bacteria to ‘forever chemicals’, a series of cases of violations or alleged pollution has prompted alarmWhen officials in Wyoming conducted a routine test on the water that was being discharged from a massive under-construction Meta datacenter, it was a shock to find it contained a rare and potentially hazardous bacterium.While the wastewater flushed into sewers in Cheyenne, Wyoming, was never destined for the public drinking supply, the presence of Cupriavidus gilardii bacterium in 801,000 gallons of water ejected by a contractor for the datacenter earlier this year was still unnerving. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 从罕见细菌到“永久性化学物质”，一系列违规或涉嫌污染的事件已引发警觉。当怀俄明州官员对Meta正在建设中的一座大型数据中心排放的废水进行例行检测时，令人震惊地发现其中含有一种罕见且可能具有危害性的细菌。尽管排入怀俄明州夏延市下水道的废水本就不属于公共饮用水供应系统，但今年早些时候，该数据中心一家承包商排放的80.1万加仑水中检出吉拉迪铜嗜菌（Cupriavidus gilardii），这一发现仍令人不安。继续阅读...
